spans.text: Buzz...
The ringing in Ange's ears grows louder as she slowly regains consciousness. Then an intense pain akin to being stabbed by a thousand needles jolts her wide awake.
The sound of gunfire feels very distant. For a brief second, she thinks she is still hallucinating.
...Urk.
Don't throw up on me, Ange.
I like my outfit.
Where am I...?
Oh, stay still, Miss Ange. The stuff is still in your system.
You're very weak right now.
The face of a stranger suddenly enters Ange's field of vision. She reaches for her weapon out of reflex but finds her holster empty.
Whoa, hold your horses!
Chill, I'm one of the good guys!
...Seeing as AK-12 has refrained from breaking your neck, I'll give you a chance to introduce yourself.
She feels a warm wetness coming down her nose. She wipes it away roughly and several drops of blood splatter on the ground.
Fighting to keep the dizziness at bay, she clenches her jaw and manages to squeeze that remark through her teeth.
You remember K?
I'm his colleague. You can call me J.
But don't worry, I'm not like him. As for what sets me apart...
Well, I can give you many examples, but I suppose the most obvious difference is in the face.
The face?
Uh, what I mean is...
I'm obviously the more handsome one.
Ange's face remains completely deadpan.
J smiles sheepishly and passes her a handkerchief.
Ange ignores it and takes out a tissue from her pouch.
...The Stasi?
She tries to shake off the wooziness. That's when she realizes that besides AK-12, she's also surrounded by multiple armed guards.
You were right on, Ange.
These Stasi blokes have been investigating this place for a while. K has already arranged for them to assist us.
You were incredibly lucky. When we arrived, you were just about to blow Miss Secretary's head open.
M-My head?
Really?!
Morridow starts frantically patting her own head in retrospective fear.
Did you just call me a "bloke"?
That didn't sound too nice.
I had only seen you in photos, but I feel like we've known each other for a lifetime!
...Gah.
Next to Ange, Morridow and Hopps aren't faring too well either. They seem to have woken up not long ago.
Morridow seems to be in especially rough shape. Compared to the strong and burly Hopps, her immune system is clearly much less robust—her face is white as a sheet.
Hopps, on the other hand, looks absolutely livid as he covers his nose with a hand.
Having a nosebleed?
...So what?
That checks out.
Do you have any idea what it was that you inhaled?
That yellow powder... Hm... I estimate that you three have less than two hours to live.
What?!
Hahahaha, your faces were hilarious!
Relax. I was just kidding. You'll be fine after some rest.
...You call yourself an agent of the Stasi?
What a joke.
Y...You scared the living daylights out of me... I was about to start writing my last will!
Looks like you've got the situation under control. Where's Leone?
We didn't see anyone else other than the three of you.
Also, you're not out of danger yet. The enemy forces that AN-94 reported are surrounding this place.
Since you're in no state to move, evacuation is impossible.
Help me up...
What kind of enemy forces are we talking about?
Just a ragtag group of thugs—nothing to worry about.
They barely know how to use their weapons.
We killed a few of them. Now they're all hovering outside, too afraid to come in.
They've probably realized that their plan was falling apart.
Yet they still refuse to give up. Other than Dolls, only those zealots would be so tenacious.
...Zealots?
Yep, as in fanatics.
The Flora Institute actually masks a cult where members have a maniacal obsession with plants and worship them.
They even believe that plants are more advanced life forms, whereas humans are mere fertilizers. Scary, isn't it?
...Paradeus?
So you've heard of Paradeus...
But no, unlike Paradeus, this is just a regular cult.
They can't be just a "regular" cult. They've got to be related to Paradeus.
You think so?
But even if you're right, that's none of my business. Paradeus isn't my case.
Sheesh, you made me break cover and just like that, my mission is now in shambles.
I haven't even finished compiling the chain of evidence.
But seeing that Miss White Wolf here is such a stunning beauty, I'll let it slide.
Can I break his fingers, Ange?
Boom!
Eeeeeep!
W-What's going on?
For someone in a weakened state, you're very loud...
I told you, they're hardly any trouble.
We'll just have to wait it out.
A commotion erupts outside the door and subsides just as abruptly.
Then...the door is slowly pushed open.
The Stasi agents raise their weapons simultaneously, but they are quite taken aback by the ones coming in.
Sorry we're late.
Not at all, 94. Your friend hasn't been slowing you down, has she?
You're right on time.
Uh... Ah!
S-So you must be the other DEFY members...!
You're just like the Valkyries!
...Well done, but it's not over yet.
They're too well-armed for a mere cult.
They've got to be storing more information and clues somewhere. Our job here isn't over until we find them.
...Where's RPK-16?
Humph... That fox has a good nose on her.
No, this isn't right... Dammit! Where did it go wrong?!
In the underground research area, Leone is huddling inside her own office.
The plan was supposed to be perfect! We...We managed to obtain so many weapons! How did we get defeated?!
Why is the Stasi here?
Even our backup forces got wiped out... You can't be serious! Nobody told me we'd be going up against a bunch of monstrous Dolls!
Those silvery white figures haunt Leone's mind like nightmarish phantoms.
Normal humans are no match for the Tactical Dolls that Angelia has by her side.
Even though they were vastly outnumbered, those ruffians given weapons with no training must have been like mere children to them.
Monsters. Oh god, they're monsters.
They wear human faces, but the things they do are beyond human comprehension.
That's what you'd call monsters.
Who... Urk!
Leone does not notice the approaching figure until she hears an amused chuckle. Unnerved, she draws a pistol from her waist by reflex.
But in just an instant, her wrist is clenched by a hand strong as a vise, and what follows is excruciating pain.
Argh... Aaaaaaaaaargh!
M-My arm!
The pain causes Leone to loosen her grip and the pistol clatters on the floor.
That's when Leone gets a clear look at her assailant—billowy hair as pale as the Devil's bones.
Watch your feet.
The grinning Doll swipes with her left leg, knocking Leone heavily onto the ground.
Leone's broken right wrist still in her deadly clasp, the Doll pins the woman down with her knee.
I do apologize.
I'm not armed, so I'm afraid I have to be rough.
You...ugh...argh!
The severe pain has jolted Leone's mind into sharp focus.
Drops of sweat glisten on her forehead. She finds it hard to believe that the Doll has snuck up to her without her noticing.
Now, could you please tell me...
Where do you store your research material?
You...wish... I will never hand it over to you basta...
Snap.
Aaaaaargh!
RPK-16 breaks Leone's right index finger.
That's not what I want to hear, you know?
The girl wears a slight smile, but her grip on the latter's broken wrist is as tight as ever.
She coos amorously into Leone's ear like a lover.
(Coughs) You...
You damn mechanical...bitch...
Still strong enough to hurl insults, eh? You've got some spine for a simple office worker, I'll give you that.
I will not...submit...to low-life like you...!
You're absolutely right. I do seem to be wasting my breath.
Snap.
Gaaah!
No... Stop! Stop it, you Devil!
Leone pants frantically.
Despite having another of her fingers broken, her reaction is a lot less intense than before, as if she is getting acclimated to the pain.
I knew it—even you are afraid of death.
Though being turned into compost is perfectly in line with your ideology.
Isn't human life supposed to be totally worthless?
So why are you clinging onto it so desperately?
You...heartless monster!
What do you know?!
Yes, I'm a werewolf; I'm a Yeti; I'm Frankenstein's monster.
But what about you?
You're just a pathetic human.
Pathetic? What...gives you the right to humiliate me?
You think you can ridicule my belief just because you have me at your mercy?
You, a mere machine?!
Can't I?
You think of yourself as a martyr, yet you're no less a coward than anyone else in face of death.
You might try to justify your cowardice by claiming that you wish to do more to further your cause.
However, you have done nothing but dance on a string to someone else's tune this whole time.
To a spectator like me...
You're not even dancing the Kazachok; you're just clowning around.
Y-You're calling me a clown?
I-I will not abide by your insults...!
I will not let you...!
How pitiful... Other than such undignified howls, don't you have anything more effective to say in your defense?
I just don't understand. Is it really so hard for humans to admit their own mistakes?
A human who believes it's wrong for humankind to exist—what a bizarre paradox.
(Gasps)
Leone clenches her teeth. She is on the verge of passing out because of the pain.
Even she doesn't know how she can still muster the strength to make rebukes in her current state.
As she struggles to keep the pain at bay, the T-Doll's sinister voice once again comes whispering into her ear.
Has it really never occurred to you...
Just how laughable your actions have been?
...What do you mean?
Your plan is way too shabby.
You may think that you still stand a good chance simply because you're now in possession of a force that's beyond your wildest imagination.
Those thugs were probably your wretched followers, but you certainly didn't conjure all those weapons out of thin air.
Leone's breath grows steadier.
RPK-16 can tell that she is slowly coming to her senses, that her words are starting to sink in.
She continues to murmur into the human's ear.
Someone must have given you those weapons, am I right? It is pretty obvious that you and your friends aren't particularly good with guns.
Not to mention, I simply can't think of any good reason for you to kill Ange.
Which means...it wasn't your idea. You're acting on orders.
I'm being used. Is that what you're trying to say?
Leone's voice grows cold.
You don't sound surprised at all.
I suppose you expected as much.
I've known that all along.
I need resources for my research; they need my research.
We've both been using each other for our own ends from the very beginning. It's a mutually-beneficial relationship. Do you think I'd feel sorry for myself because of that?
She sneers triumphantly, believing that she has outsmarted RPK-16.
You have a point. You ARE an intelligent scientist.
You may not be a woman of the world, but you are not that gullible.
I suppose you have absolutely no problem with being sacrificed like a pawn?
...Sacrificed?
A relationship is only "mutually-beneficial" when both parties acknowledge each other's value.
Unfortunately, you have chosen a terrible partner to begin with. You ask a tiger for its hide, and you end up getting toyed with like a rat.
Your role in this operation is a pawn to be sacrificed, nothing more. Do you still believe you're in control?
What is that supposed to mean?
Exactly that.
The one who gave you this task knew all along that you wouldn't succeed.
He pushed you into the fire and is clapping at the show on his own spectator's stand.
...You're a lousy interrogator.
You think I'd buy your terrible lies?
Now I feel sorry for you. I'm surprised you still have any faith in them.
Do you honestly believe that the reason your plan is in shambles, that is, our involvement in this matter, is pure coincidence?
What are you getting at?
Ange's visit was a spontaneous decision, yet you were thoroughly prepared.
They're so well-informed, I'm starting to wonder if they've planted a mole...
But if Ange can't take a crap without them noticing, isn't it odd that they didn't take her T-Dolls' strength into consideration?
...You Dolls look no different than humans.
You say that, but you're also starting to have your doubts, aren't you?
Hm, that's a good sign.
Now let me ask you another question. If you had really wanted to kill Ange...
Why would your partner give you nothing but weapons?
You might have been unaware of our strength, but surely your partner should've told you?
He knew none of your followers were trained professionals, yet he didn't lend you a single soldier. Stingy, isn't he?
RPK-16 lets go of Leone's hand.
Do you understand now?
That's because weapons are cheap, while trained soldiers are very expensive.
Leaving that aside, you don't even seem to have what remotely looks like a backup plan.
Let me guess. Your partner didn't arrange for your escape, did he?
The weapons, the accurate information...
These were all nothing but a smokescreen?
As I said, a sacrificed pawn is all you are. That's the unmistakable truth.
He was just testing the waters to gauge our strength with your little stunt.
I'm sure he's very happy with the results.
He's probably also having a good laugh over how stupid you and your friends are.
Even so, do you still insist that what you did wasn't entirely pointless?
...I was tricked?
Would you like me to give you an answer?
I've always known this is how it would end...
I just didn't expect it to happen so soon.
You have my respect.
Only a moth would know how mesmerizing the flame is.
...You'll find what you want on the server. The physical key is behind the second drawer of the desk.
Look for it yourself.
Thank you.
RPK-16 slowly releases Leone and backs off a few paces to give her some room to collect herself.
Without even a glance at the scrambling human, she turns away and strolls towards the computer with one hand on the back of her neck.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Consecutive shots are fired and sparks fly off RPK-16's slender back.
When she turns around, she sees Leone pointing the revolver that was lying on the floor straight at her.
...Why would you fire at a T-Doll in a bulletproof vest with a gun of that kind of caliber?
You know it wouldn't leave a scratch on me.
Bang!
RPK-16 tilts her head as a bullet brushes past her cheek, a glint of bright silver displacing the tip of her hair.
Why didn't you kill me?
My objective is to obtain those data.
You're the one who knows where they're stored.
But I've already given you the location.
I haven't confirmed it... Do you want me to kill you?
Compared to being humiliated by those sickening idealists, I much prefer this ending.
But I have no desire of putting you out of your misery.
Or should I say, there's no point in doing that.
...I've answered your questions and given you what you want. Now it's your turn to answer mine.
If you'd been abandoned by the world and things were utterly hopeless, would you choose to die?
Death is humans' prerogative. It's something I'm extremely envious of.
Humph... So THIS is our so-called "future"?
Haha, what a joke...
Leone pauses before letting out a sardonic chuckle.
If you are the "future", then I'd rather...
She slowly turns the muzzle of the gun towards herself and presses it against her left temple.
RPK-16 watches without batting an eyelash.
Click!
...Leone pulls the trigger, but the chamber is empty.
RPK-16 wipes her cheek with a thumb.
I counted correctly. That was the last round.
...Even fate has betrayed me at this point.
It wasn't fate that betrayed you; it was yourself.
YOU made all the choices, and it was YOU who fired all the shots.
RPK-16 ignores Leone, who is in utter despair, and turns to the computer.
She unwraps the bandages around her neck to reveal a hidden "collar" before placing her case onto the desk.
She plugs herself in and turns on the computer.
...Oh my.
However...
We've been...bamboozled.
There is nothing on the hard disk.
The research data, the communication logs with "a certain organization", and whatever else that RPK-16 expected to find, all of it is gone.
RPK-16 looks at Leone.
If only it were your doing.
At least you would have achieved something with your pitiful life.
Still, judging by the handiwork... They must've cleaned up long ago.
Right, I see.
She smiles mockingly.
In the end, he played us all like fiddles.
(Footsteps)
...There you are.
Oh, you found me.
Give me a heads-up next time you wander off.
What's the situation?
All information and research data have been wiped clean.
It doesn't seem to be Miss Leone's doing.
Our enemy is one step ahead of us.
I know.
This visit is just my way of saying hello.
What's the matter with her?
Who knows? Probably lost all hope.
Did you do this to her?
At least she's still alive. That's better than being dead, right?
...Humph.
If she knows she's gonna spend the rest of her life in prison, she'll probably want to die.
Humans really do understand each other. She tried.
You're a sick bastard.
Hand her over to the Stasi for interrogation.
Come to think of it, I'm a bit curious.
Do you believe the world's future lies in plants?
Of course not. What a load of crap.
If plants could solve all the problems, why would they need us to do all the dirty work?
What, did she convert you?
I don't know. What do you want me to say?
We Dolls are not unlike plants. Some humans consider us the future. They give us a purpose and hope we can point them towards "the correct path".
But who is to tell us what is correct?
If plants aren't the answer, are we?
Did Leone brainwash you or something?
No, observing her behavior just gave me some food for thought.
...Alright, enough of your philosophical epiphany.
Bring her back with us, this isn't over yet.
Your wish is my command, my lady.
